[RDSC.4c.3] **In this edition a runtime skips every `CompiledCode` atom.**
The runtime **must** dispose of one, whatever its `arch`, as [RDSC.9.4]
disposes of an unrecognised atom in the skip band, and **must not** map, wire
or execute the code it carries: ahead-of-time compiled code is deferred
([RAOT.1]), and no compiler of this edition emits the atom. The rest of the
artefact loads as it would without the atom, and the runtime interprets every
node.
